query:
SELECT count(*) AS "total!"
  FROM (
        SELECT 1
          FROM tools.results r
          JOIN tools.uses tu ON tu.id = r.tool_use_id
          JOIN requests.requests rq ON rq.id = tu.request_id
          LEFT JOIN projects.projects p ON p.id = rq.project_id
         WHERE r.is_error
           AND ($1::timestamptz IS NULL OR r.created_at >= $1)
           AND ($2::timestamptz IS NULL OR r.created_at < $2)
           AND ($3::text IS NULL OR p.project_path ILIKE '%' || $3 || '%')
           AND ($4::text IS NULL OR tu.tool_name = $4)
         LIMIT $5
       ) capped
